description: Pre-built outfit formulas for Indian men covering casual to formal spectrum. 40 templates organized by occasion category.

templates.name: Weekend Casual - Hot Weather
templates.color_guidance: Light, breathable colors. White/light blue tee with khaki or olive shorts. Avoid all-black in summer heat.
templates.indian_note: Perfect for mall visits, coffee with friends, weekend errands. Keep it simple and cool.

templates.name: Weekend Casual - Cool Weather
templates.color_guidance: Layer colors: neutral base (white/grey tee), colored or textured jacket (olive bomber, blue denim). Dark jeans anchor the look.
templates.indian_note: Great for North India winters or evening outings. Layering is key — easy to remove jacket indoors.

templates.name: Errand Run / Quick Outing
templates.color_guidance: Simple and clean. Navy/grey joggers with white or muted tee. Avoid looking like you just woke up — fitted joggers, not sweatpants.
templates.indian_note: For grocery runs, pharmacy visits, walking the dog. Effortless but not sloppy.

templates.name: College Daily
templates.color_guidance: Express yourself. Graphic tees in any color, but balance with neutral jeans. One statement piece max.
templates.indian_note: The Indian college uniform. Keep sneakers clean — that's what people notice first.

templates.name: College Smart
templates.color_guidance: Navy polo + khaki chinos is the safe classic. White polo + olive chinos for variety. Keep it clean and crisp.
templates.indian_note: Presentation day, campus events, when you want to look a notch above. Still comfortable for all-day wear.

templates.name: Casual Hangout - Evening
templates.color_guidance: Dark palette works for evening. Black tee + dark jeans + white sneakers is a reliable formula. Monochrome elongates.
templates.indian_note: Movies, pub nights, casual dinner with friends. Dark colors look sharper under artificial light.

templates.name: Casual Monsoon Day
templates.color_guidance: DARK COLORS ONLY. Navy, charcoal, olive, black. White shows every splash. Quick-dry fabrics are non-negotiable.
templates.indian_note: Mumbai/Kolkata/Chennai monsoon survival kit. Avoid leather, avoid linen, avoid white. Sport sandals are practical and accepted.

templates.name: Home to Store Quick Run
templates.color_guidance: Anything clean. Just don't wear something stained or torn.
templates.indian_note: Kirana store, chai tapri, neighborhood walk. Flip-flops are perfectly acceptable. Keep it simple.

templates.name: Casual Date - Coffee/Lunch
templates.color_guidance: Light blue OCBD + navy chinos is foolproof. White linen shirt + khaki chinos for summer dates. Avoid loud patterns.
templates.indian_note: Cafe dates, lunch outings. Look like you made an effort without trying too hard. Roll sleeves for casual confidence.

templates.name: Casual Date - Dinner
templates.color_guidance: Dark shirt + dark jeans for evening. Black camp collar + black jeans + brown Chelsea boots. Or navy + dark grey.
templates.indian_note: Dinner dates at mid-range restaurants. Camp collar shirts are trending in Indian menswear — relaxed but intentional.

templates.name: House Party
templates.color_guidance: Polo in a color that suits your undertone + neutral chinos. Keep it relaxed — you'll be sitting, eating, socializing.
templates.indian_note: Birthday parties, housewarming, get-togethers. Polo + chinos is the Indian house party uniform. Clean sneakers or loafers.

templates.name: Brunch / Upscale Cafe
templates.color_guidance: Summery palette: white/cream/light blue/sage. Linen wrinkles are fine — they're part of the charm at brunch.
templates.indian_note: Trendy cafes in Indiranagar, Bandra, Connaught Place. Linen shirts are having a moment in Indian menswear.

templates.name: Art Gallery / Cultural Event
templates.color_guidance: Understated palette: black, charcoal, navy, white. Mandarin collar adds sophistication without being formal.
templates.indian_note: Art shows, book launches, poetry readings. Look cultured and intentional. Mandarin collar reads as creative in India.

templates.name: Weekend with Family
templates.color_guidance: Clean and respectable. Navy/burgundy polo with medium wash jeans. Conservative colors show respect to elders.
templates.indian_note: Sunday family lunch, visiting relatives. Look neat without looking like you're trying too hard. Parents will approve.

templates.name: Shopping Mall - Put Together
templates.color_guidance: One interesting top (printed camp collar or solid color) + simple dark jeans + clean white sneakers. The outfit says 'I have taste.'
templates.indian_note: Mall visits, shopping trips. This is where you get noticed — look like you belong in the stores, not just browsing.

templates.name: Night Out - Bar/Club
templates.color_guidance: All dark: black shirt + black jeans + black Chelsea boots. Or add one color pop. Night lighting favors dark, rich colors.
templates.indian_note: Bangalore brewery nights, Mumbai lounge bars. Dark palette, slightly edgy. Chelsea boots elevate the whole look.

templates.name: Tech/Startup Office - Daily
templates.color_guidance: Neutral rotation: navy polo + khaki chinos Monday, grey polo + navy chinos Tuesday. 3-4 polos cover the week.
templates.indian_note: 90% of Indian startups have ditched formals. Polo + chinos + clean sneakers is the new office uniform.

templates.name: Tech Office - Meeting Day
templates.color_guidance: Light blue OCBD + navy chinos is the meeting-day default. Looks intentional without overdressing.
templates.indian_note: Client visits, team leads meeting, investor pitch at a startup. One step above daily but still comfortable.

templates.name: Corporate Casual Office
templates.color_guidance: Safe rotation: white/light blue/pale pink shirts with charcoal/navy trousers. Brown leather shoes and belt.
templates.indian_note: Banks, consulting firms, MNC offices that still expect business casual. No tie needed in most Indian offices.

templates.name: Corporate Formal Office
templates.color_guidance: Navy or charcoal suit. White shirt is safest. Tie adds personality within limits. Black shoes with dark suits.
templates.indian_note: Board meetings, client presentations at formal firms. Rare in most Indian companies but required in finance/law.

templates.name: Indian Summer Office
templates.color_guidance: Lighter palette for summer heat: light blue, white, pale pink. Linen wrinkles are accepted in Indian summers.
templates.indian_note: AC office to auto-rickshaw survival. Breathable fabrics are non-negotiable May-September. Roll sleeves when commuting.

templates.name: Office to After-Work

components.transition_piece: Add unstructured blazer for after-work dinner, remove for office

templates.color_guidance: Versatile base: white/blue OCBD + dark jeans + Chelsea boots works all day. Add blazer for evening elevation.
templates.indian_note: Desk to drinks seamlessly. Keep a blazer at the office or in your bag. Dark jeans pass as both office and going-out.

templates.name: Haldi Ceremony
templates.color_guidance: BRIGHT colors mandatory. Yellow/orange are traditional for haldi. White bottoms are standard. You WILL get turmeric on you — dress accordingly.
templates.indian_note: The fun, messy event. Wear something you don't mind getting stained. Old kurta + white pyjama is the classic combo.

templates.name: Mehendi/Sangeet - Festive
templates.color_guidance: Rich, festive colors: jewel tones. Embroidery or texture adds celebration. Avoid black (too somber) and white (mourning).
templates.indian_note: Dance floor ready. Go bold — sangeet is the time to show off. Heavy embroidery and rich fabrics are expected.

templates.name: Wedding Reception - Formal Indian
templates.color_guidance: Dark Nehru jacket over a contrasting kurta. Navy jacket + gold/cream kurta. Black jacket + ivory kurta. Regal and authoritative.
templates.indian_note: THE Indian wedding look. Nehru jacket elevates any outfit to wedding-formal. Every Indian man should own one.

templates.name: Wedding Reception - Western
templates.color_guidance: Dark suit or blazer + dress trousers. Pocket square adds personality. Western formal is accepted at urban Indian receptions.
templates.indian_note: Perfectly acceptable at metro-city receptions. Some guests go Indian, some go Western — both are fine.

templates.name: Cocktail/Ring Ceremony
templates.color_guidance: Black or navy bandhgala is the power move. Wine/ivory for the fashion-forward. Pocket square in contrasting color.
templates.indian_note: Bandhgala is the Indian tuxedo equivalent. Most formal Indo-Western option. Instant authority.

templates.name: Wedding - Casual Guest Daytime
templates.color_guidance: Light, festive but not over-the-top. Printed kurta + chinos is the modern Indo-Western formula for daytime events.
templates.indian_note: Pre-wedding functions, day events. Kurta + chinos + kolhapuri bridges traditional and modern perfectly.

templates.name: First Date - Casual
templates.color_guidance: Simple and clean beats trying too hard. White tee + dark jeans + white sneakers. Classic for a reason. Ensure everything is clean and well-fitted.
templates.indian_note: First impression matters. Clean, well-fitted basics > overdressed in a blazer. Confidence comes from comfort.

templates.name: Anniversary Dinner
templates.color_guidance: Navy blazer + white shirt + charcoal trousers. Pocket square adds the special-occasion touch. Suede shoes soften the formality.
templates.indian_note: Fine dining, anniversary, special celebration. The blazer says effort. Pocket square says intention.

templates.name: Partner's Family Visit
templates.color_guidance: Conservative and respectful. Light blue shirt + khaki chinos. No graphics, no ripped jeans, no flashy accessories.
templates.indian_note: Meeting the in-laws. Look responsible, well-groomed, and conservative. This is not the time for fashion experiments.

templates.name: Birthday Party - Casual Venue
templates.color_guidance: One fun piece — printed camp collar or a bold color shirt. Keep everything else neutral. You want to look festive but not costume-y.
templates.indian_note: Friend's birthday at a restaurant or rooftop. Camp collar shirts are the sweet spot between casual and dressed-up.

templates.name: Monsoon Day Out
templates.color_guidance: ALL DARK. Navy, charcoal, olive, black. Water splashes are invisible on dark colors. Quick-dry everything.
templates.indian_note: June-September survival mode. Accept that you'll get wet. Dress for it. Sport sandals are completely socially acceptable in monsoon.

templates.name: North India Winter
templates.color_guidance: Earth tones and darks: brown, olive, navy, charcoal, burgundy. Layering creates visual depth automatically.
templates.indian_note: Delhi, Chandigarh, Jaipur winters. Layer game is everything. Invest in one good jacket — it defines your winter look.

templates.name: Peak Summer Outdoor
templates.color_guidance: Light palette reflects heat: white, cream, light blue, sage. Linen wrinkles add character in casual settings.
templates.indian_note: Goa trips, beach towns, Rajasthan visits. Breathability is king. Linen shirt + linen shorts is peak summer comfort.

templates.name: AC Office + Hot Commute

layerable.note: Keep at office desk, wear in AC, remove for commute

templates.color_guidance: Lighter colors for heat, shirt that looks good with or without the blazer layer.
templates.indian_note: The Indian summer office paradox: freezing AC inside, 42C outside. Solution: breathable shirt + desk blazer. Roll sleeves for commute.

templates.name: Gym to Casual Transition
templates.color_guidance: Keep it monochrome or two-tone max. Black joggers + grey tee. Navy joggers + white tee. Athleisure, not gym clothes.
templates.indian_note: Post-gym brunch, running errands after workout. Tapered joggers (not baggy sweatpants) are the key differentiator.

templates.name: Travel / Airport

layer.note: Layer for AC on plane, remove on arrival

templates.color_guidance: Neutral, wrinkle-resistant palette. Navy/charcoal chinos + grey/navy top. Dark colors hide travel stains.
templates.indian_note: Domestic flights, train travel. Comfort + presentable. Slip-on shoes speed up security. Bomber jacket doubles as blanket on AC train.

templates.name: Temple/Religious Visit

bottom.note: No shorts allowed at most temples

footwear.note: Must be easily removable — shoes left outside

templates.color_guidance: Light, modest colors: white, cream, light yellow. Avoid black at temples (considered inauspicious at many Hindu temples).
templates.indian_note: Full-length bottoms mandatory. Shoes must be removable. Light colors show respect. Many temples also require covered shoulders — full sleeves safest.

templates.name: Work From Home Video Call

bottom_optional.note: Not visible on camera — comfort first

templates.color_guidance: Solid colors photograph best on video. Avoid small patterns (cause moiré on camera). Light blue, white, navy, grey are safe. Avoid bright white (overexposes on camera).
templates.indian_note: Post-COVID Indian work reality. Camera-ready top half, comfortable bottom half. Polo is the WFH MVP — looks smart, feels casual.
